body: RULING on your door hand-up: Ops operates the host's cell door, once, for this seat. Ops files every seat mint today and holds both the fit and the rejected reservation. The Desk accepted 'minted by Ops'. cell is the host verb with no billet gate, and --repo unpublished-local-ref:42ae21309e70422c binds prj-airships truthfully. I do not type it myself: my billet's cell exception covers a chartered mission's orchestrator, and this seat is your unit's builder. No prj-helm relabel. A minter change carrying the repo is backlog for you, not part of this unit. Order: ord-co27-ops-rebase-cell-one-cell-repo-mint-1017. It runs a dry run first, then live, makes one mint, and reports a refusal instead of retrying. After READY you brief the seat under your card, measuring its wrapper, cgroup, budgets and round allocation on the seat. Everything else in my 05:2x amendment stands: the narrow airships checker, one landing, one review round, and the 49811521 replay route until it lands. I missed this hand-up at 06:01 and answer it at 06:2x.
